market_summary: USD strength was dominant during the London/NY overlap, pushing XAUUSD, EURUSD, and GBPUSD into sharp downside expansions below their respective Value Areas and near lower ATR bands. Meanwhile, US100 displays strong bullish trend momentum breaking out to new session highs above VAH. BTCUSD holds above VWAP but faces immediate structural resistance.

signals.rationale: Price is below VAL (4033.66) and below POC (4043.60). CVD is NEUTRAL (-1.08) with a mild positive slope (0.93). Session is LONDON_NY_OVERLAP. Price is trading below VWAP (4041.66) and EMA50 (4039.11), hovering near the lower ATR band (4013.59) after sweeping down to test Session Low (4000.54) with elevated RVOL. However, price is stretched far outside the ATR lower band and bouncing off 4000 support, making a fresh short entry risky right at the bottom.

Price is trading below VAL (1.11139) and well below POC (1.11376). CVD is strongly BEARISH (-14,562). Session is LONDON_NY_OVERLAP. Price is well below VWAP (1.11314) and EMA50 (1.11307). Recent aggressive sell-off printed yellow RVOL spikes, breaking below Prev Low (1.11456) down to test lower ATR band (1.10960). Price is currently consolidated near Session Low (1.10824) with low RVOL on the current bar, suggesting extended downside stretch where momentum has temporarily paused.

Price is located below VAL (1.32911) and POC (1.33475). CVD is BEARISH (-3,591) with positive short-term slope recovery. Session is LONDON_NY_OVERLAP. Price remains well below VWAP (1.33113) and EMA50 (1.33127), trading at the lower ATR band (1.32776). Strong selloff broke Prev Low (1.33119) down to Session Low (1.32661) with RVOL yellow spike. The last signal bar formed a small bullish rejection candle off the lows. Position is extended at lower ATR band, cautioning against immediate shorting.

Price is above VAH (28292.93) and above POC (28272.18). CVD is BULLISH (+10.56) with positive slope (+2.39). Session is LONDON_NY_OVERLAP. Price is strong and trending cleanly above VWAP (28142.58) and EMA50 (28179.49), expanding past the upper ATR band (28399.62) to make new Session Highs (28445.08). Note US100 index CFD rarely prints RVOL > 2.0; strong multi-bar bullish momentum and market structure align cleanly with overall trend.

Price is above VAH (73869.38) and above POC (73650.62). CVD is slightly BEARISH (-0.06) with flat slope, showing mild divergence. Session is LONDON_NY_OVERLAP. Price is above VWAP (73683.60) and EMA50 (73716.12), trading mid-to-upper channel near S/R (73975.30). A bullish expansion candle broke above EMA50, but wick rejected near 74085.20 without RVOL confirmation (>2.0). Range condition persists below strong S/R levels.
